subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30m product tour and stakeholder alignment
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@arkai.io>, Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@arkai.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: scheduling 30m product tour and stakeholder alignment

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — good to hear more about how Arkai is thinking about inference for their search and embeddings pipeline. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (very short)
- Use case: nearline vector search + ranked results for product catalog (200M+ items)
- Key constraints: sub-50ms 99p latency for search hits, on-prem requirement for audit logs, predictable monthly spend
- Stakeholders: Product (Alex), Engineering (Jamie), Security/Infra (Samir)

Proposed next step
We recommend a 30-minute product tour (high-level walk-through of Redwood inference runtime and ops) first, followed by a separate 60-minute technical deep-dive if the engineering/security teams want to dig into performance/config. Can you confirm we should schedule the 30m product tour with the stakeholders above?

Availability grid (PT) — pick one:
- Option A: Tue May 12, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Option B: Wed May 13, 14:00–14:30 PT
- Option C: Thu May 14, 11:30–12:00 PT

If none of these work, share 2–3 time blocks that do (we'll align). When you pick a slot, can you also confirm the attendees (names + roles) so we include the right demo personas?

Mutual action items (draft)
- Redwood: send product one-pager + SOC2 redacted doc link (by EOD Monday)
- Arkai: confirm slot + attendee list (by EOD Tuesday)

Attachments: redwood-product-onepager.pdf (attached)

Thanks — I’ll draft a calendar invite once you confirm a time.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Thanks, Kimberly — appreciate the clear recap. All three stakeholders should attend the 30m product tour:
- Alex Carter (Product) — me
- Jamie Liu (Eng lead)
- Samir Patel (Security/Platform)

Of the times you listed, Option C (Thu May 14, 11:30 PT) looks best for us. If that slot gets taken, fallback would be Option B.

Two quick questions before we lock: 
1) Can you confirm whether the product tour will touch on our on-prem deployment options + KMS integrations? That’s top of mind for Samir.
2) We’ll want SOC 2 evidence — is the redacted link okay to share ahead of the 30m? If so, please send.

Also, we have a short planning call with procurement next week; I can loop procurement into the calendar invite if helpful.

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming attendees. We’ll lock Option C: Thu May 14, 11:30–12:00 PT. I’ll send a calendar invite to the list (including procurement if you like — just confirm the contact).

To answer your questions:
- Yep — the 30m product tour will include a slide on deployment modes (hosted / dedicated / private), our VPC/on-prem footprint, and KMS/HSM integrations at a high level. We won’t deep-dive into keys in that session, but we will show the integration patterns and options.
- I’ll send a redacted SOC 2 evidence link ahead of the meeting (attached link + short note in the calendar invite).

Updated mutual action plan (with dates)
- Redwood: deliver redacted SOC2 + product one-pager (Mon May 11)
- Arkai: confirm procurement contact if they should be included in the invite (Tue May 12)
- Redwood: share calendar invite + agenda (by Tue May 12 EOD)

Planner note: if engineering wants a deeper technical session, we recommend a 60-minute deep-dive focused on latency profiling, quantization options, and key routing strategies — we can propose slots after the 30m.
